text: The future of AI is a popular topic today. Many experts believe that artificial intelligence will change our lives in big ways. Some people talk about general AI, which can do many different tasks, and AGI, or artificial general intelligence, which could think like a human. Supporters say AI may bring great benefits, such as better healthcare and easier work. However, there are also risks, like job losses and safety problems. Experts disagree about when AGI might arrive. Some think it is close, while others believe it is many years away. In the end, the future of AI depends on how carefully we develop and use it.
